messages:
Eve: Quick microcopy review for the 'Revert rollout' confirmation modal. Current primary CTA is 'Revert' and support reported a user clicked it by mistake. Screenshot in thread.
Harper: Oof. 'Revert' is ambiguous out of context. We should make the action explicit and show consequence. Options: 'Revert rollout (non-recoverable)' is too long.
Ravi: Suggestion: primary CTA = 'Revert rollout now' and make the destructive nature explicit in the body: 'Reverting will switch all traffic back to the previous model and may change responses for active users.'
Liz: Also include a small checkbox: 'I understand this may affect live traffic' to add a friction step. If we add it, update the CTA to be disabled until checked.
Eve: Accessibility: modal should be role="alertdialog" and the CTA should have an aria-label that repeats the consequence, e.g., aria-label="Revert rollout now; will restore previous model and affect live users". Focus should move into the dialog and to the checkbox.
Harper: Copy variants to review:
1) Direct: Title: 'Revert rollout' Body: 'This will restore the previous model and route all traffic to it. Live responses may change.' CTA primary: 'Revert rollout now' Secondary: 'Cancel'
2) Safer: Title: 'Revert rollout?' Body: 'Are you sure you want to revert? This may change live responses for users currently interacting with the model.' Checkbox: 'I understand this will affect live traffic.' CTA primary: 'Confirm revert'
3) Minimal: Title: 'Revert' Body: 'Restore previous model.' CTA primary: 'Revert' (not recommended)
Ravi: I prefer variant 2 for safety. The checkbox adds a deliberate confirm step and the CTA 'Confirm revert' reads clearly.
Liz: Microcopy for toast on success: 'Rollout reverted. Traffic is now routed to {previous_model_name}.' Also include a small link 'View rollout history'.
Eve: UX question: do we include a countdown for blue-green style rollbacks? Legal asks us not to promise instantness. Use 'propagating now; may take a few minutes.'
Harper: Localization: avoid contractions, keep body <120 chars where possible. Checkbox label should be short.
design-bot: Task created: UI-ROLLBACK-77 "Revert rollout modal copy + a11y" Assigned: Harper, Ravi Due: 2024-09-15
Ravi: I'll add aria attributes and keyboard flow in the component PR.
Harper: I'll update Figma with the checkbox variant and final strings.
Eve: Final call: ship variant 2. Use 'Confirm revert' as primary CTA, disabled until checkbox checked. Add aria-label to CTA that echoes the consequence.
Liz: I'll draft the exact i18n keys and post them here when ready.
Eve: Thanks team 44d
Harper: Leaving a tiny nit: change checkbox copy to 'I understand this will affect live traffic and responses.' Slightly clearer.
Ravi: Agreed. I'll reflect that in the PR notes.
